title: Crosstalk between two striplines: 0.2 mm strips 0.2 and 0.4 mm apart, centred between planes 0.8 mm apart in εr 4.3
source: S. B. Cohn, Shielded coupled-strip transmission line, IRE Trans. MTT 3, 1955, pp. 29–38 (the even and odd impedances of edge-coupled striplines of no thickness, exact by conformal mapping); C. R. Paul, Analysis of Multiconductor Transmission Lines, 2nd ed., Wiley 2008, §7.3 (weakly coupled matched lines: near end (k_L + k_C)/4, far end (k_C − k_L)/2 · T_d/t_r). Reference values evaluated independently of EMCraft from the published formulas.

quantities.reason: The finite elements' capacitance and inductance couplings of the pair's cross-section against Cohn's exact even and odd impedances (in one dielectric k_L = k_C = (Z_e − Z_o)/(Z_e + Z_o)): a difference of the two modes, so twice their error.
